description: This file implements the WarningReportingUnit class, which manages warning reporting categories, their configurations, and event reporting within the WPEFramework. It includes methods for singleton access, category management, default settings handling, and warning event reporting.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing warning reporting categories, their configurations, and reporting warning events within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::WarningReportingUnit()
methods.description: Constructor initializing categories and lock, and registering the instance with the proxy.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Instance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of WarningReportingUnit.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::~WarningReportingUnit()
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up categories and unregistering the instance.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::GetCategories()
methods.description: Returns a list of category names currently managed.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::AddToCategoryList()
methods.description: Adds a category control to the internal list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::RemoveFromCategoryList()
methods.description: Removes a category control from the internal list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Defaults()
methods.description: Returns the default categories configuration as a JSON string.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Defaults(const string&)
methods.description: Sets the default categories configuration from a JSON string.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::UpdateEnabledCategories()
methods.description: Updates internal enabled categories and applies configuration to category controls.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::FetchCategoryInformation()
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific category.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::ReportWarningEvent()
methods.description: Reports a warning event with associated information.
